output.summary: The evidence does not support the board's framing. Per-concert sales do not differ by repertoire (E7), and core attendees renew at a stable 85-86% (E5), so programming is not the main driver. Peer orchestras lost a median 29% of ticket revenue without moving venue (E10), so the 30% decline is roughly regional. A venue effect is still visible: the single-ticket step-drop coincided with the Brightwater move (E4), cathedral concerts sold far better (E11), and the exit survey cites transit and parking (E12). Marketing is untested. Recommend a segmented analysis before the contract vote, use of the cathedral dates, a shuttle pilot, and no non-renewal on revenue grounds.
